metadata.title: Micron and Sandisk stocks might look like bargains, but analysts say that’s actually a red flag - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Micron and Sandisk stocks might look like bargains, but analysts say that’s actually a red flag
Cheap valuation multiples for memory stocks have historically been associated with peak pricing levels, according to analysts
Memory stocks were among the biggest decliners as the technology sector bled red ink on Friday.
Shares of Micron Technology MU closed down 14% on Friday, while shares of Sandisk SNDK fell 16%. Western Digital’s stock WDC sank 12%.
